Strategy: Shift the gentle fifteen sweet band downward to residuals between twenty-five and forty while keeping the mid penalty at fifteen. This tests whether slightly tighter leftovers work better with gentle steering, but the shifted band may match fewer real item sizes.
```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (15 if r - item >= 25 and r - item <= 40 else 0) - (15 if r - item >= 8 and r - item <= 22 else 0) for r in bins]
```
